## Evaluation rules (non-negotiable; violations make a record invalid)
1 TRIALS. A trial is every distinct (signal, parameters, horizon, universe, filter, cost model) whose result you looked
  at. Keep a Python list TRIALS and append on every evaluation. Your first Board post states your trial budget. Stop at
  the budget and file. Every record reports trials_used and trials_budget; kind trial-ledger lists them (name,
  params, n, net_bps) up to 60 rows plus the count of the rest.

  evaluate Y once, report per-year net bps/trade, hit rate and Sharpe. No pooled in-sample number is a result.

  path, same costs). A candidate must beat the MAX of the 200 on the walk-forward test years, not only zero. Report
  placebo_max and placebo_p95.

  a negative or inconclusive record, never as a candidate.

  second half of test years and trend by year), n_trades, trades per symbol, results with BTC/ETH/SOL excluded and with

## Record contract: submit_finding(task_id, result={"papers":[...]}). Required: id, title, file, description, severity

```python
"""Pre-submit contract lint. Workers paste this verbatim into run_code (it is embedded in the protocol)."""
import json

REQ = ["id", "title", "file", "description", "severity"]
SEV = ["breakthrough", "useful", "background", "negative"]
KINDS = ["candidate", "negative-result", "trial-ledger", "method", "data-issue", "swarm-improvement",
         "wave-plan", "referee-report", "wave-digest", "final-report"]
NEED = {"candidate": ["spec_code", "claim", "metrics", "limitations", "decision", "kill_criterion"],
        "negative-result": ["claim", "metrics", "proof", "decision"],
        "trial-ledger": ["metrics"], "referee-report": ["claim", "metrics", "proof", "decision"],
        "wave-plan": ["decision", "evidence"], "swarm-improvement": ["evidence", "decision"]}


def lint(records, seed_urls):
    errs, seen = [], set()
    if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
        return ["papers must be a non-empty list"]
    for i, r in enumerate(records):
        w = f"rec[{i}]"
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            errs.append(w + " not an object"); continue
        for k in REQ:
            if not isinstance(r.get(k), str) or not r[k].strip():
                errs.append(f"{w} missing/empty required string field {k}")
        if r.get("id") in seen:
            errs.append(f"{w} duplicate id {r.get('id')}")
        seen.add(r.get("id"))
        if r.get("severity") not in SEV:
            errs.append(f"{w} severity must be one of {SEV}")
        if r.get("file") not in seed_urls:
            errs.append(f"{w} file must be exactly one of seed_urls")
        if r.get("kind") not in KINDS:
            errs.append(f"{w} kind must be one of {KINDS}")
        for k in NEED.get(r.get("kind"), []):
            if r.get(k) in (None, "", [], {}):
                errs.append(f"{w} kind {r.get('kind')} needs {k}")
        if any(v is None for v in r.values()):
            errs.append(f"{w} has a null value")
        blob = json.dumps(r)
        if "/work/" in blob or "/tmp/" in blob:
            errs.append(f"{w} points at an ephemeral path; inline the code instead")
        if len(r.get("spec_code", "")) > 7000:
            errs.append(f"{w} spec_code over 7000 chars")
        if r.get("kind") == "candidate":
            m = r.get("metrics") or {}
            for k in ["trials_used", "trials_budget", "per_year", "net_bps_per_trade", "n_trades", "placebo_max",
                      "top3_day_share", "top3_name_share", "decay", "beats_placebo_max", "mde_ok"]:
                if isinstance(m, dict) and k not in m:
                    errs.append(f"{w} metrics lacks {k}")
    if len(json.dumps(records)) > 150_000:
        errs.append("filing over 150 KB; shorten")
    return errs

```

## Referee duties (you are independent of the worker who filed the candidate)
Step 1 re-derive: from the DESCRIPTION only (not the spec code), rebuild the signal from /dataset bars and compare with
the claimed numbers; /dataset/raw_check holds raw aggregate trades for 3 symbols x 2 days to verify bar building.
Step 2 attack: look-ahead (shift the signal by -1 bar and by +1 bar, scramble the future), survivorship (only symbols

embargo >= horizon), overlap inflation, cost sensitivity (19 bps all, +5 bps), funding, concentration, decay, parameter

Step 3 ONE LOOK: write the final evaluation code, print its sha256, run it ONCE on /dataset/confirm (2026-05-01 to
2026-10-22, lockbox weeks absent) and report the result whatever it is. Never tune after that look. Log
the look in metrics (look_sha256, look_n_trades, look_net_bps). Verdict: confirmed / not confirmed / invalid, kind
referee-report, with every attack's numbers.

If you have a concrete improvement for how this swarm is prompted, structured or tooled, add one swarm-improvement record
with evidence from this run. Never end your turn without submit_finding.

# f24 robustness: xsec 7d momentum on Binance USDT-M perps, h=24h, k=5, with 200-shuffled-day placebo
# Data: /dataset/discovery/bars_5m/<SYM>/*.parquet (closed 5m bars only). Daily close = last 5m close of the UTC day,
# so the signal from day d is tradable at the open of day d+1 (sig_day = d+1). No look-ahead.
import glob, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
SYMS = sorted(os.listdir("/dataset/discovery/bars_5m"))
rows=[]
for sym in SYMS:
    df = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(f, columns=["ts_ms","close","quote_volume"]) for f in
                    sorted(glob.glob(f"/dataset/discovery/bars_5m/{sym}/*.parquet"))]).dropna(subset=["close"])
    df["day"] = (df.ts_ms // 86_400_000).astype(np.int64)
    g = df.groupby("day")
    o = pd.DataFrame({"close": g.close.last(), "qv": g.quote_volume.sum()}); o["sym"]=sym
    rows.append(o.reset_index())
D = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True).sort_values(["sym","day"]).reset_index(drop=True)
g = D.groupby("sym")
D["lr"]   = np.log(D.close).groupby(D.sym).diff()
D["mom7"] = g.close.transform(lambda s: s/s.shift(7)-1)          # 7-day momentum, known at close of day d
D["vol7"] = g.lr.transform(lambda s: s.rolling(7, min_periods=5).std())
D["fwd24"]= g.close.transform(lambda s: s.shift(-24)/s-1)        # close(d+1) -> close(d+25), 24h hold
D["sig_day"] = D.day + 1
def xsec(df, col, k=5, minn=10):
    d = df.dropna(subset=[col]).copy()
    d = d[d.groupby("sig_day")[col].transform("count") >= minn]
    cnt = d.groupby("sig_day")[col].transform("count")
    d["rk"] = d.groupby("sig_day")[col].rank(pct=True); d["w"]=0.0
    d.loc[d.rk >= 1-k/cnt, "w"] = 1.0; d.loc[d.rk <= k/cnt, "w"] = -1.0
    return d
def ls(d, fwd):                       # per-leg average return, non-overlapping daily entries
    d = d.dropna(subset=[fwd]).copy(); d["pnl"] = d.w*d[fwd]
    gg = d.groupby("sig_day"); n = gg.w.apply(lambda s: (s!=0).sum())
    return (gg.pnl.sum()/n.replace(0,np.nan)).dropna()
d = xsec(D,"mom7"); r = ls(d,"fwd24"); yr = pd.to_datetime(r.index*86_400_000, unit="ms").year
print("test(>=2022) gross bps/trade", round(r[yr>=2022].mean()*1e4,1), "net19", round(r[yr>=2022].mean()*1e4-19,1))
# 200 shuffled-day placebos: permute whole days of the signal within symbol, same code path, same costs
S = d.pivot_table(index="sig_day", columns="sym", values="mom7"); F = d.pivot_table(index="sig_day", columns="sym", values="fwd24")
days = S.index.values; rng = np.random.default_rng(20261028); outs=[]
for b in range(200):
    Sp = pd.DataFrame(S.values[rng.permutation(len(days))], index=days, columns=S.columns)
    cnt = Sp.notna().sum(axis=1).values[:,None]; rk = Sp.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    W = pd.DataFrame(0.0,index=days,columns=S.columns).mask(rk.ge(1-5/cnt),1.0).mask(rk.le(5/cnt),-1.0).where(Sp.notna(),0.0)
    P = ((W*F).sum(axis=1)/(W!=0).sum(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan)).dropna()
    yb = pd.to_datetime(P.index*86_400_000, unit="ms").year
    outs.append(P[yb>=2022].mean()*1e4)
outs=np.array(outs); print("placebo max", round(outs.max(),1), "p95", round(np.percentile(outs,95),1))

```python
"""Pre-submit contract lint. Workers paste this verbatim into run_code (it is embedded in the protocol)."""
import json

REQ = ["id", "title", "file", "description", "severity"]
SEV = ["breakthrough", "useful", "background", "negative"]
KINDS = ["candidate", "negative-result", "trial-ledger", "method", "data-issue", "swarm-improvement",
         "wave-plan", "referee-report", "wave-digest", "final-report"]
NEED = {"candidate": ["spec_code", "claim", "metrics", "limitations", "decision", "kill_criterion"],
        "negative-result": ["claim", "metrics", "proof", "decision"],
        "trial-ledger": ["metrics"], "referee-report": ["claim", "metrics", "proof", "decision"],
        "wave-plan": ["decision", "evidence"], "swarm-improvement": ["evidence", "decision"]}


def lint(records, seed_urls):
    errs, seen = [], set()
    if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
        return ["papers must be a non-empty list"]
    for i, r in enumerate(records):
        w = f"rec[{i}]"
        if not isinstance(r, dict):
            errs.append(w + " not an object"); continue
        for k in REQ:
            if not isinstance(r.get(k), str) or not r[k].strip():
                errs.append(f"{w} missing/empty required string field {k}")
        if r.get("id") in seen:
            errs.append(f"{w} duplicate id {r.get('id')}")
        seen.add(r.get("id"))
        if r.get("severity") not in SEV:
            errs.append(f"{w} severity must be one of {SEV}")
        if r.get("file") not in seed_urls:
            errs.append(f"{w} file must be exactly one of seed_urls")
        if r.get("kind") not in KINDS:
            errs.append(f"{w} kind must be one of {KINDS}")
        for k in NEED.get(r.get("kind"), []):
            if r.get(k) in (None, "", [], {}):
                errs.append(f"{w} kind {r.get('kind')} needs {k}")
        if any(v is None for v in r.values()):
            errs.append(f"{w} has a null value")
        blob = json.dumps(r)
        if "/work/" in blob or "/tmp/" in blob:
            errs.append(f"{w} points at an ephemeral path; inline the code instead")
        if len(r.get("spec_code", "")) > 7000:
            errs.append(f"{w} spec_code over 7000 chars")
        if r.get("kind") == "candidate":
            m = r.get("metrics") or {}
            for k in ["trials_used", "trials_budget", "per_year", "net_bps_per_trade", "n_trades", "placebo_max",
                      "top3_day_share", "top3_name_share", "decay", "beats_placebo_max", "mde_ok"]:
                if isinstance(m, dict) and k not in m:
                    errs.append(f"{w} metrics lacks {k}")
    if len(json.dumps(records)) > 150_000:
        errs.append("filing over 150 KB; shorten")
    return errs

```

# Family f08: volatility-regime conditioning of a taker-flow signal (Binance USDT-M perps, 5m bars)
# Self-contained: numpy/pandas + /dataset only. No network.
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, glob, json
m=json.load(open("/dataset/manifest.json")); syms=list(m["symbols"].keys())
T0=1577836800000; T1=1776902400000; STEP=300000
grid=np.arange(T0,T1,STEP,dtype=np.int64); N=len(grid); S=len(syms)
COLS=["ts_ms","close","high","low","quote_volume","signed_usd","rv_tick"]
C=np.full((N,S),np.nan,np.float32); QV=np.full((N,S),np.nan,np.float32)
SD=np.full((N,S),np.nan,np.float32); RV=np.full((N,S),np.nan,np.float32)
for j,s in enumerate(syms):
    d=pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(f,columns=COLS) for f in sorted(glob.glob(f"/dataset/discovery/bars_5m/{s}/*.parquet"))],ignore_index=True)
    d=d[(d.ts_ms>=T0)&(d.ts_ms<T1)].sort_values("ts_ms")
    i=((d.ts_ms.values-T0)//STEP).astype(np.int64)
    C[i,j]=d.close.values; QV[i,j]=d.quote_volume.values; SD[i,j]=d.signed_usd.values; RV[i,j]=d.rv_tick.values
logC=np.log(C.astype(np.float64)).astype(np.float32)
def rsum(x,w): return pd.DataFrame(x).rolling(w,min_periods=max(2,w//2)).sum().values.astype(np.float32)
def rrank(x,w): return pd.DataFrame(x).rolling(w,min_periods=max(5,w//2)).apply(lambda a:(a[:-1]<a[-1]).mean(),raw=True).values.astype(np.float32)
rv1h=rsum(RV,12)                                   # 1h tick realised variance (closed bars only)
volrank=rrank(rv1h,2016)                           # rank of rv1h in own trailing 7 days, in [0,1]
flow24=rsum(SD,288)/(rsum(QV,288)+1e-9)            # 24h taker signed flow / 24h notional
sig=np.where(volrank<0.5,flow24,np.nan)            # vol-regime filter: only LOW-vol regimes
# funding actually crossed (long pays rate at each settlement in (entry, exit]); NaN if unknown
F={}
for s in syms:
    fs=sorted(glob.glob(f"/dataset/discovery/funding/{s}/*.parquet"))
    if fs:
        d=pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(f) for f in fs],ignore_index=True).sort_values("ts_ms")
        F[s]=(d.ts_ms.values.astype(np.int64),d.rate.values.astype(np.float64))
H=48; COST=19.0
r=np.full(logC.shape,np.nan,np.float32); r[:-H]=logC[H:]-logC[:-H]   # close(t)->close(t+H), entry at open(t+1)
FM=np.full((N,S),np.nan,np.float32)
for j,s in enumerate(syms):
    if s not in F: continue
    ts,rt=F[s]; cum=np.concatenate([[0.0],np.cumsum(rt)])
    ent=grid+STEP; ex=ent+H*STEP
    FM[:,j]=(cum[np.searchsorted(ts,ex,side="right")]-cum[np.searchsorted(ts,ent,side="right")]).astype(np.float32)
net=r*1e4-COST-FM*1e4                              # bps, net of round trip and funding
idxs=np.arange(0,N-H,H)                            # NON-OVERLAPPING entries every H bars
s=sig[idxs]; rr=net[idxs]; pnl=np.sign(s)*rr; ok=~np.isnan(pnl)
yr=np.array(pd.to_datetime(grid,unit="ms").year)[idxs][:,None]*np.ones_like(pnl)
print("net bps/trade",round(float(pnl[ok].mean()),2),"n",int(ok.sum()),"hit",round(float((pnl[ok]>0).mean()),3))
print({y:round(float(pnl[ok&(yr==y)].mean()),2) for y in [2022,2023,2024,2025,2026]})
# 200 shuffled-day placebos: permute whole days of the signal within symbol, same code path
rng=np.random.default_rng(20261028); day=((grid-grid[0])//86400000).astype(np.int64); d=day[idxs]
first={}
for i,x in enumerate(d):
    if x not in first: first[x]=i
ud=np.unique(d); st=[]
for k in range(200):
    mp=dict(zip(ud,rng.permutation(ud))); src=np.array([first[mp[x]] for x in d])
    p=np.sign(s[src])*rr; o=~np.isnan(p); st.append(float(p[o].mean()))
st=np.array(st)
print("placebo max",round(float(st.max()),2),"p95",round(float(np.percentile(st,95)),2),"z",round((pnl[ok].mean()-st.mean())/st.std(),2))
candidate.title: Taker-flow imbalance in low-volatility regimes: +14.2 bps/trade net at 4h on 50 Binance perps (beats 200-day placebo max)
